main_text.p: סורחבן Chal. Rebellis, contumax, Deut. 21.18. in Targ. Jonath. Plural. סרהבנין, Genef. 26.35. in T. H. Idem quod supra סרבן.

סרח Chald. Iniquè, Malè, Perversè agere, Peccare, Sic & Syr. femel, ܟܐܢ ܐܫܟܐ ܠܐ ... Quum nil mali, perversi egisset ei quicquam, Luc. 4.35. Item Foetere: Item Redundare, Redundans, Superfluum esse, ut Hebr. Exo. 26.12.
סריח סרוח Ch. Redundans, Superfluum: Item Foetidum, putridum. Foemin. סריחא.
סורחנא, סורחן Ch. Iniquitas, perversitas, peccatum.
סרט Pahel Ch. Lineare, lineas ducere, signare, designare, 1. Sam. 21.3.
ܣܪܛ Syr. Apex litterae, Matth. 5.18. Item Linea, ut in exemplari N. T. Viennensi, in annotatione erratorum typographicorum, ubi quandoque integrè, quandoque abbreviatè ܣܪܛ scribitur.
סרטיא, אסרטא, סרטא Ch. Strata, Via, Semita. Plural. סרטיתא, סרטין.
סרך Chal. Pervertere, evertere, subvertere. Pahel Infin. לסרכא Ad pervertendum, Then. 3.25.
סריך Ch. Perversum, perplexum. Foem. סריכתא.
סרכא סרכא Chald. Eparchus, Exarchus, Moderator, Gubernator, Praefectus. Plur. סרכין, סרכיא.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac script is transcribed as far as legible; some vowel points and Syriac forms are approximate and marked as doubtful in the printed text. The Syriac line in the "Sic & Syr." entry is illegible in parts. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
